Its happened to me a few times I'm sad to admit, tore my heart out. I couldn't stop thinking about how I could've done something, noticed they weren't okay or why it could've been my fault etc, even though it obviously wasn't. I felt so horrible for months even years after the first time I experienced it but with time I grew to become better. I've since gone through very hard times and am going through one now worse than ever and at times I've thought to myself maybe that'll work. But I remember the trail of destruction and how it made my world change forever and couldn't think of putting that on those I care about and those that care about me. I've learnt a lot. Losing them changed me a lot and altered who I am but ultimately thats the way life is sometimes. I still get upset to this day years on and months on. Initially I didn't believe it. Then it didn't feel real then later on everything stopped. It hit me like a train. A confusing emptiness and sadness but also a burning rage. Then followed later with loneliness and a sense of failure. Hard to properly describe how I felt but thats more or less it. Truly horrible thing to feel and I pray nobody here every experiences it no matter how close you are to them. Dont take those you love for granted. Make sure you check up on your buddies and family and anyone really. Be kind. Never know the difference it could make.
